entries.title: Knowledge Room scope (MECH-K0)
entries.body:
The Knowledge Room is a single-host, local-only knowledge product in Utopia.

It creates, edits, searches, filters, deletes, exports and imports plain text knowledge entries. It binds to 127.0.0.1 only and has no dependency on the Gateway, a runtime node, Android, or any cloud service.

Anything beyond plain text (attachments, embeddings, semantic search) is explicitly out of scope for K0.

entries.title: Import policy: IMPORT_MODE = replace
entries.body:
V0 has exactly one import strategy: the imported bundle replaces the entire current data set.

There is no merge and no conflict resolution. A payload is either accepted whole or rejected whole; a rejected import leaves the existing data untouched.

The bundle must declare format "utopia-knowledge-room" and schemaVersion 0.

entries.title: Durability rules for the JSON store
entries.body:
Data lives in apps/knowledge-room/runtime-data/knowledge-v0.json with schemaVersion 0.

Every save writes a temporary file in the same directory and renames it over the target, so an interrupted write can never truncate the store. Real user data is not committed to Git; only runtime-data/.gitkeep and a nested .gitignore are tracked.
